title: Impact alignment hand-off outline and sprint notes
summary: Personal prep doc for manager sync: concise evidence, asks, handoff checklist, and 2-week sprint plan.
body:
Goal: make the 1:1 with my manager (weekly) laser-focused: state wins, surface risks, make 2 clear asks, show measurable evidence, and confirm handoff items.

Top-line claims (elevator):
- Reduced time-to-hire for IC infra roles from 42 -> 32 days (pilot routing + templated interview guides).
- Launched calibration rubric for L4->L5 that highlighted 6 promotion-ready candidates; filed 3 promotion notes.
- Short experiments cut onboarding new-hire ramp from ~6 weeks -> 4.5 weeks for eng new grads (buddy program + checklist).

Concrete evidence to bring:
- Candidate funnel doc: link (CONFLUENCE) + screenshots of ATS metrics (conversion by stage).
- Promotion case synopses: 3 bullets each per candidate, direct impact examples.
- New-hire survey before/after (NPS + time-to-first-PR).

Manager asks (choose two):
1) Endorse promotion packet for Maya R. and green-light cross-functional announcement (ask for timeline + sponsor).
2) Approve + fund 8-hr vendor UX audit for onboarding flows (budget ask: $15k).
3) Alignment slot w/ Eng leadership to pilot hiring funnel change for Dataplane team (2-week pilot).

Handoff checklist (if I need to pause or hand to Ethan):
- Docs: /confluence/people-ops/onboarding-v2 (owner added), promotion-case-templates.md (owner: Maya).
- Active tickets: HR-543 (onboarding tweaks), HR-612 (interview panel rotation) — add notes in ticket, tag Ethan.
- Slack channels: add Ethan to #new-hire-ops, pin the one-pager.
- Weekly cadence: transfer ownership of weekly eng sync; provide meeting notes + agenda template.

Open questions / risks to surface in 1:1:
- Data fidelity: ATS timestamps inconsistent for two roles; need a short audit (who owns?).
- Bandwidth risk: vendor audit will require me to coordinate — need partial backfill or deprioritize another project.
- Promotion timing: comp review timeline may shift approval window.

2-week sprint plan (if manager wants tactical next steps):
Week 1:
- Finalize promotion packets (mon-wed).
- Run quick data audit on ATS timestamps (thu).
- Draft vendor RFP + share to manager for approval (fri).
Week 2:
- Start pilot with Dataplane (kickoff mon).
- Collect first-week onboarding survey responses + quick fixes.
- Draft announcement and identify sponsor for promotions.

Notes to self (phrasing for 1:1):
- "Quick update: three promotion packets ready — show 1 example and a 30s impact statement"
- "I want your call on whether we prioritize the vendor audit or push the funnel pilot out one quarter."
- "If you sign off on the budget I can commit to vendor scoping next week; otherwise can run a lightweight internal review."

Prep artifacts to attach to 1:1 calendar invite:
- 1-pager (impact + asks) as PDF.
- Promotion example (redacted) + rubric.
- Short dashboard screenshot of time-to-hire by role.

Quick checklist before the meeting:
- [ ] Export ATS graphs and annotate trends.
- [ ] Put promotion synopses into 1-pager.
- [ ] Draft budget justification for vendor audit.
- [ ] Confirm attendee list + desired outcome for each ask.

After-meeting capture template (fill immediately):
- Decisions made: 
- Action owners + due dates:
- Follow-ups (who to loop in):

Random brainstorming (seed ideas):
- Micro-incentive for interviewers (small recognition badges) to improve panel turnout.
- 10-minute "first PR" checklist sent via email on day 1 with examples.
- Hire an onboarding research intern (cheap, 10hrs/week) to run interviews and free up me/vendor time.

Little reminders: keep language crisp, quantify impact, avoid long histories in 1:1 — save background doc for later.

Unresolved: need manager confirmation on what counts as "promotion-ready" signal for L4s (is shipping a cross-team feature enough?).

End of scratchpad.
